narration: Someone on a modest salary can beat a high earner on that one fraction.
caption: कम सैलरी वाला भी इस एक अनुपात में ज़्यादा कमाने वाले से आगे निकल सकता है।
image_brief: Two unequal stacks of coins on a wooden bench, the shorter stack topped with a folded paper slip, morning light across the grain.

narration: One number can be worked out in a minute from last month's figures.
caption: पिछले महीने के आँकड़ों से यह एक नंबर मिनट भर में निकल आता है।
image_brief: A single bank statement page on a kitchen table with a pen laid across it and a glass of tea beside it, early light from a window.

narration: It converts into something concrete. Months of future freedom bought per year worked.
caption: यह ठोस चीज़ में बदल जाता है: एक साल की मेहनत से मिले आज़ादी के महीने।
image_brief: A wall calendar with three of twelve month boxes shaded in pencil, the rest blank, soft indoor daylight.

narration: A second conversion follows. Any monthly commitment turns into the lump sum behind it.
caption: दूसरा हिसाब भी है: हर मासिक खर्च के पीछे छिपी बड़ी रकम।
image_brief: A small printed subscription card standing upright beside a thick brick of banded banknotes on a desk, cool overhead light.

narration: Then the limits. The arithmetic breaks in two situations, and both matter.
caption: फिर सीमाएँ। यह गणित दो हालात में टूट जाता है, और दोनों अहम हैं।
image_brief: A wooden ruler snapped in two pieces lying on a sheet of graph paper, hard daylight from the left.

narration: And the reframe. Why a raise is not progress until part stays unspent.
caption: और नया नज़रिया: सैलरी बढ़ना तरक़्क़ी नहीं, जब तक कुछ हिस्सा बचे नहीं।
image_brief: An unopened pay envelope propped against a locked steel cash box on a shelf, warm lamp light from one side.

narration: Start with what the pot is for. It replaces spending, not income.
caption: पहले देखें फंड किस लिए है। वह खर्च की जगह लेता है, कमाई की नहीं।
image_brief: A stack of household bills weighed down by a stone on a table, a tall empty glass jar standing behind them, window light.

narration: Nobody needs to fund a salary forever. Bills are what need funding.
caption: किसी को हमेशा के लिए सैलरी नहीं चाहिए। चाहिए बिल भरने का इंतज़ाम।
image_brief: An electricity bill, a rent receipt and a grocery list laid in a row on a bedsheet, flat afternoon light from a doorway.

narration: So the size of the pot is set by one year of spending.
caption: इसलिए फंड का आकार एक साल के खर्च से तय होता है।
image_brief: A large brass vessel on a floor mat with twelve small cloth pouches arranged in a circle around it, soft daylight.

narration: A common rule of thumb multiplies that year by twenty-five. It is illustrative.
caption: एक आम मोटा नियम उस साल को पच्चीस से गुणा करता है। यह उदाहरण भर है।
image_brief: Twenty-five identical clay cups arranged in a five by five grid on a stone floor, even overcast light from above.

narration: Why twenty-five? It assumes a modest slice is drawn each year while the rest keeps working.
caption: पच्चीस क्यों? हर साल थोड़ा हिस्सा निकले और बाक़ी काम करता रहे।
image_brief: A round steamed cake on a plate with one thin slice lifted slightly away from the whole, kitchen window light.

narration: The exact multiple is argued over. The direction of the logic does not change.
caption: सही गुणक पर बहस होती रहती है। पर तर्क की दिशा नहीं बदलती।
image_brief: Two brass weights of slightly different sizes sitting on the two pans of a balance scale in a shop, dusty afternoon light.

narration: Now watch the first link. Spending appears on both sides of the arithmetic.
caption: अब पहली कड़ी देखें। खर्च गणित के दोनों तरफ़ खड़ा है।
image_brief: A folded paper boat on the surface of a full water trough with a second identical boat on the far side, bright noon light.

narration: On one side it shrinks the amount that gets saved this month. Directly.
caption: एक तरफ़ यह इस महीने की बचत को छोटा कर देता है। सीधे-सीधे।
image_brief: A thin sheaf of banknotes inside a drawer that is half open, the rest of the drawer bare wood, dim light from the room.

narration: On the other side it enlarges the pot that every future year needs.
caption: दूसरी तरफ़ यह आगे के हर साल के लिए ज़रूरी फंड को बड़ा कर देता है।
image_brief: A tall earthen storage jar towering over a small one on a barn floor, straw scattered around, light from an open door.
